<div class="card-body">
'''CZ-3 (Seezee-Three)''' is the Japanese-language [[Premiere (Japanese)]] printing of [[CZ-3 (Seezee-Three)]].<ref name="encyclopedia">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41 and 97 (index 3920). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>


<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">CZ-3（シーズィー・スリー）</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ＣＺ－３のいるロケーションか、そこに隣接した位置で、相手が戦闘、フォース消耗を宣言した場合、リアクションとしてそのロケーションにカードを配備できる。配備コストは通常通り支払う。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-cz-3-seezee-three-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">サーヴォドロイド社製造のＣＺ通信ドロイド。旧型だが広く使われている。コムリンクを内蔵し、優れたスクランブラーと暗号化機能を持つ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' CZ-3 (Seezee-Three).

'''Card text:''' When your opponent declares a battle or Force drain at CZ-3's location or an adjacent site, you may deploy cards to that location as a react. Pay the normal deployment costs.

'''Lore:''' A CZ communications droid manufactured by Serv-O-Droid. An older model that remains widely used. It has a built-in comlink and sophisticated scrambling and encryption capabilities.
